scope: Assessment of credential-free and already archived routes represented in this case's source registry and retained evidence. It does not assert that no provider anywhere can supply the required data under a future entitlement.

nonqualifying_routes.failure_boundary: The samples are not an entitled, complete point-in-time archive and lack a lifecycle master, dated effective terms, full-session coverage, historic availability, execution evidence and reconciliation required for actual-contract selection, roll or P&L.

nonqualifying_routes.observed_value: A fixed exploratory four-ETF daily-bar observation with price_basis=forward_adjusted_or_unknown.
nonqualifying_routes.failure_boundary: It is neither an official point-in-time market-price/NAV/event ledger nor historical execution evidence; it cannot establish investor total return or UR01/UR03 compliance.

nonqualifying_routes.observed_value: Documentation names ETF and actual-futures endpoint families that could supply relevant fields.
nonqualifying_routes.failure_boundary: No token, paid entitlement, provider-rights attestation, raw response archive, retention/derivation permission, data owner, available_at/revision archive or acceptance-test result exists. Documentation alone is not a qualifying route.

nonqualifying_routes.observed_value: Metadata-only WAF/challenge or not-found probe records.
nonqualifying_routes.failure_boundary: No response body or contract fact was retained; these records cannot close a rule, lifecycle or access requirement.

required_packages.required_scope: Every ETF in the future frozen decision universe; the five current ETF codes are illustrative only.
required_contents: Dated instrument identity, exchange, listing/status and universe-effective dates.
One canonical session OHLC, prior close, volume and amount row for every expected active-instrument/session, subject only to documented exceptions.
NAV, accumulated or adjusted NAV, NAV date, announcement timestamp and IOPV or an explicit unavailable state.
Distribution/corporate-action type, ex/record/payment dates, amount and adjustment factor, reconciled so every cash event is recognized once.
Halt, price-limit, session-phase and tradability status.
Per-record as_of, available_at, vendor-publication time, retrieval time, revision and raw hash, with no decision before available_at.
Entitlement, raw/normalized hash-chain, coverage, primary-key, event-reconciliation and conflict acceptance tests.
gaps: No entitlement record with retention, normalization, replay, derived-analytics and independent-review rights.
No complete class-wide point-in-time ETF price/NAV/IOPV/event/status archive, source-vintage history or raw manifest chain.
No verified adjustment-to-event reconciliation or source-consistent trading-status history.
No dated broker-route, quote/depth, cost, tax or fill evidence needed where this ledger touches UR03.

required_packages.required_scope: Every actual listed AU, CU and TA contract in the future frozen universe on every decision session; continuous, retrospectively labeled main-contract and vendor-synthesized series are prohibited for selection, roll and P&L.
required_contents: Contract lifecycle: contract, exchange/product, listing, last-trade, delivery and position-restriction dates.
Effective rule/specification: multiplier, tick, quote unit/currency, sessions and final-settlement/delivery method.
Full daily cross-section with prior settlement, OHLC, settlement, volume, turnover and open interest, reconciled to the contemporaneous lifecycle master.
Dated exchange/broker margin, fee, upper/lower limit and position-limit terms; variation and final-settlement timing.
Trading, limit-lock, delivery and eligible-successor state.
Per-record as_of, available_at, vendor-publication time, retrieval time, revision and raw hash, plus expected-contract-count and pagination retention.
Entitlement, lifecycle/term, full-cross-section, actual-contract, roll, marking and availability acceptance tests.
gaps: F05/F06 are only six retrospectively retrieved dates per exchange, not a complete point-in-time archive or a full futures population census.
No retained lifecycle master, effective historical rule/margin/fee/limit/position/delivery terms, historic available_at or contract-count reconciliation.
No entitlement/retention/replay right, raw delivery manifest chain, historical bid/ask/depth or broker-route fill evidence.
Failed rule probes contain no admissible contract facts.

required_packages.required_scope: Dated broker-route, exchange/session, tax and liquidity evidence for every instrument considered in paper replay or prospective reconciliation.
required_contents: Broker-route identity, commission, minimum fee, tax/levy and effective dates.
ETF lot, tick, trade date, settlement date, available-to-sell-from, T+1, halt and limit mechanics; futures brokerage fee, margin, restrictions, delivery and final-settlement handling.
Quote timestamp/age, bid/ask and depth, or a predeclared conservative impact/no-fill method supported by source evidence.
Route/account/scope-specific cash, debit, collateral, margin and settlement-transfer terms, including day-count, compounding, accrual and immutable term-set identity.
Execution side plus quote, submission, fill, expiry and settlement causality with a monotonic state-transition ledger.
Session phase/status and as_of, available_at, revision and raw-hash provenance.
A later prospective reconciliation must retain at least 60 calendar days and 10 distinct eligible observations, including one per admitted U0 parent class.
gaps: No dated broker route, fee, tax, margin, quote/depth, market-status or order/fill/settlement evidence exists.
No immutable cash-collateral term set or monotonic order-state-transition ledger exists.
No accepted conservative fill/no-fill methodology is bound to source evidence.
No prospective paper-reconciliation period or observed-versus-modelled exception ledger exists.

A U0-to-T2 derivation audit containing per-class population/qualified/excluded counts, each T2 parent class, pre-frozen inclusion rule, inclusion/exclusion reason and approved exceptions.
An accepted class-specific data/replay module for every U0 parent class represented in T2; otherwise any future test is explicitly coverage-restricted.

No frozen U0 snapshot, source-population manifest, class counts or item-level U0-to-T2 audit exists.
No represented class has an accepted data/replay module; the current ETF/AU/CU/TA rows remain illustrative probes.

least_expansive_external_prerequisite.principle: Do not expand the research universe or infer a result from public samples. First obtain one auditable entitlement-and-delivery bundle for the explicitly frozen prospective scope; if one lawful provider cannot cover every module, obtain equivalent module-level bundles with the same controls. The CFFEX historical-data service is a documented future financial-futures procurement lead, not a present authorization or a complete multi-asset solution.
minimum_external_bundle: A provider legal-entity/product identity and written permission covering retention, normalization, formal replay, derived analytics and independent review, together with terms version, effective/expiry dates, redistribution/audit/deletion rules and credential-custody/lapse procedure.

An immutable raw delivery/archive and manifest for ETF_PIT_EVENT_LEDGER, FUTURES_ACTUAL_CONTRACT_LEDGER and EXECUTION_AND_COST_LEDGER, with source as_of, documented available_at, vendor-publication time, retrieval time, revision, raw hash, coverage expectation and response/page/row counts.

Primary venue/product population masters sufficient to create and freeze the U0 snapshot and a class-neutral U0-to-T2 derivation audit; every class represented in a future test must receive its accepted data/replay module.
Dated broker-route and, where relevant, suitability evidence without assuming the user's access; the later paper period remains a separate UR05 requirement.
explicitly_not_sufficient: A credential, successful request, payment receipt, API schema or data-service page alone.
Retrospective download of a historic row without source-provided historic availability.
A public adjusted-or-unknown daily-bar series, a continuous futures series, or a finite convenient probe universe.
Any entitlement/delivery bundle by itself: UR04 must still be frozen before outcomes are viewed and UR05 must still pass before a usable-strategy upgrade.
An unarchived source-link reconnaissance result: it is not a local raw source and cannot close a gate until the corresponding primary evidence and written terms are retained.
least_expansive_external_prerequisite.current_effect: Until the bundle is accepted against the package tests and U0 controls, no data collection result can be treated as a formal replay input; q remains 0.

open_follow_on_gates.boundary: A hash-bound, result-blind formal replay protocol/rulebook/U0 snapshot/U0-to-T2 audit/data dictionary must be frozen before outcome inspection.
Independent R0/R1/risk review and the prospective paper-reconciliation thresholds remain required after the data and protocol gates.
